content.name: Mules-Supply-Mod-OPUS
content.description: A supply-focused derivative of Mules, Supply and Warehouses Extended 6.60. Independent ship dispatch, bounded multi-stop throughput planning, live availability and per-ship diagnostics. See README.md for changes and test status.
content.author: Mules-Supply-Mod-OPUS contributors; based on MoistDreams, BHayden53, Galaxy Spam and earlier authors
